title: Validate tasks.json on loop startup
description: Before starting the loop, validate tasks.json against the TaskSchema. If validation fails, print a detailed Zod error message showing which task and field is invalid, then exit.
acceptanceCriteria: A tasks.json with a missing 'title' field causes a clear validation error before the loop starts
Error message shows which task ID and field are invalid
Process exits with non-zero code on validation failure

steps.details: In reader.ts, the TasksFileSchema.parse() call already throws a ZodError on invalid input. Ensure this error is properly caught and re-thrown with a user-friendly message.

steps.description: Format ZodError for user display in preflight
steps.details: In preflight.ts, catch ZodError from readTasks: `try { tasks = await readTasks(agentDir) } catch (e) { if (e instanceof z.ZodError) { console.error('Invalid tasks.json:'); e.errors.forEach(err => console.error(` Path: ${err.path.join('.')}, Error: ${err.message}`)); process.exit(1) } throw e }`
Create a test tasks.json with a task missing the 'title' field. Run rocket loop and verify the error message clearly identifies the missing field.

technicalNotes: ZodError.errors is an array of ZodIssue objects — each has path, message, and code fields
